legend.notes: Sentences quoted verbatim from the catalog page that state a condition we could NOT express as structure — exclusions ("Research courses may not be used"), eligibility lists, per-course grade minimums. legend.creditsRequired: Semester hours the catalog states for a section whose courses it does not list. Do not add these into a program total: some restate credit that another section already counts.
